name: benchmark-annotations
description: A dataset of human annotations created to support evaluation of model outputs; it contains labeled judgments or metadata for benchmark examples to enable quantitative comparison of model behavior. The collection is intended to be used for calculating standard evaluation metrics and for training/validating evaluation pipelines. It is a utility-style dataset rather than a task-specific benchmark.
reputation: A small, user-contributed annotations dataset with limited but practical use for researchers needing human labels for benchmark examples.
